g.text: When user joins 'user:status' event is broadcast by backend so other clients know about this user.
if socket connects then 'connection-status' is emitted.
Send list of users and their status.
Client emits 'conversation:fetch' and 'messages:fetch' to fetch conversation with a particular user or all messages.
Client of the intended recipient shows who is typing. Clears after 3 seconds.
emits 'typing-stop' after user clicks away from text box.
Clears typing message on the intended recipient.
checks if sender has exceeded rate limit and content size.
Use callback to return error if ratelimit or size exceeded.
emits 'message:received' to sender and reciever or broadcasts to all(if no recipient specified)
Updates message delivery status to delivered.
Updates the message delivery status to read.
Backend emits 'message:status' event to the sender of the message.
Deletes the tokens stored in localstorage.
Backend notifies other users similar to when user had joined.
